BIOL 210 Course Agenda Overview

Fall 2026

agenda-overview.Rmd

Weekly Agenda Links

Agenda Dates Topics
Week 1 Aug 26-28 Course Introduction; Biodiversity, Phylogenies, Cells
Week 2 Sep 02-04 Eukarya, Genomes, Eukaryotic genomes
Week 3 Sep 07-11 Mitosis, Meiosis, Life cycles
Week 4 Sep 14-18 Genes, Transcription, RNA processing
Week 5 Sep 21-25 Translation, Sex determination, Inheritance and segregation
Week 6 Sep 28-Oct 02 Dominance, Independent assortment, Linkage
Week 7 Oct 05-09 Hardy Weinberg, Detecting evolution, Genetic variation
Week 8 Oct 12-16 Mutation, Gene flow, Genetic drift
- Oct 19-23 Fall Break
Week 9 Oct 26-30 Nonrandom mating, Selection, Heritability
Week 10 Nov 02-06 Speciation, Population Ecology, Life History
Week 11 Nov 09-13 Interspecific interactions, Competition
Week 12 Nov 16-23 Community structure, Ecological succession, Energy flow
- Nov 26-28 Thanksgiving Break
Week 13 Nov 30-Dec 04 Biodiversity patterns, Nutrient cycling
Week 14 Dec 07-09 Behavior, Learning, Genetics of behavior
